notes: Version 2.20 retypes the Q7 entry for Q7 version 2.0, which states the requirements an equivariant bridge would have to meet and withdraws the Casimir reading of the central coefficient, the isotropy fit, the transfer of a discrete compression to the continuum symbol, and the coefficient values imported from Q8, Q10, U1 and Q11. Q7 records three hypotheses supplied by no source: the identification [ID] of the measured space with the spin-1 module, the adjoint su(2)-action [ACT] on the real spatial sector, and the J_3-invariance [INV] of the admissible regime. The Q7 row becomes proved for the requirements on the supplied carrier with the identification open, and is redrawn in both figures and in the interactive graph; the Q7-to-Q9 edge and the terminal edge into the co-metric result box leave the spine; in the interactive graph the O29-to-Q7, Q7-to-Q8 and Q7-to-Q9 edges carry explicit typing; the Q5a-to-Q5b-O3 chain is no longer recorded as closed. The Q8, Q10, U1, W1 and Q11 entries are marked pending revision on the surfaces that assert their results, each pending its own step in this cascade, and the Lorentz-capacity entries carry the same marker on the coefficient values they consume.
